patch_description: Key parameters in prior approaches: congestion_factor (1.5, penalized load), max_candidates (4), and per-partition round-robin assignment. New configuration inverts the load penalty into a reuse reward: process destinations in decreasing shortest-path-cost order and, per partition, select the candidate path maximizing (reuse_bonus * reused_edges - raw_cost). Parameters: reuse_bonus = 0.9 (fraction of cost credited back for each edge already used by an earlier destination in the same partition), max_candidates = num_partitions + 2, and a fallback alternation threshold of 15% cost increase to allow mild diversification when reuse offers no gain. Rationale: if cost is charged per unique edge (or with aggregate-flow discounts), reusing edges across destinations within a partition reduces total transfer cost while keeping the `[s, t, G[s][t]]` append format unchanged.
